readback.name: Poincare.DeTurckPartialCoefficientSmoothness.contDiffAt_partialLower
readback.mathematical_statement: E is the fixed real three-dimensional Euclidean space ClosedSmoothModel 3. Bilin is E ->L[R] E ->L[R] R, Jet1 is E ->L[R] Bilin, Background is E ->L[R] E ->L[R] E, and BackgroundDerivative is E ->L[R] Background. MetricJet is Bilin times Jet1 and Joint is (Background times BackgroundDerivative) times MetricJet. The actual pinned partialLower : Joint -> (MetricJet ->L[R] Bilin) maps p=((B,DB),(G,J)) to the existing DeTurckJetLinearization.lowerDifferential B DB G J. This is fderiv R at (G,J) of the actual map (g,j) |-> DeTurckPrincipalIdentity.lowerTerm B DB g j, with the basepoint background maps B and DB held fixed during that partial derivative. It is not a supplied or chosen abstract coefficient operator. Its linear-map argument h=(hG,hJ) contains only metric and first-jet variations; no background variation is included in h. For every arbitrary basepoint B,DB,G0,J0, assume only G0.IsInvertible as a continuous real-linear map E -> E dual, meaning it is the forward map of a continuous linear equivalence. Then the entire CLM-valued partialLower map is C-infinity at ((B,DB),(G0,J0)) in Joint. Thus the coefficient map varies smoothly with all four basepoint variables B,DB,G,J, even though each resulting linear operator acts only on hG,hJ. B and DB are arbitrary independent bilinear/trilinear E-valued maps and need not be realized as a background field and its derivative. G0 need not be symmetric or positive-definite, and J0 need not be a realized or symmetric metric jet. No determinant/unit, curvature, chart, derivative-package, or coefficient-bound premise is assumed. C-infinity is ContDiffAt R at the ENat top injected into WithTop ENat, rather than the outer top regularity value. The conclusion is smoothness in the actual operator-norm topology of MetricJet ->L[R] Bilin, not merely scalar smoothness after applying the coefficient to selected directions or tensor slots. The literal locally selects the canonical Mathlib CLM normed additive groups and real normed spaces for Jet1 and both background spaces, explicitly fixing real scalars and RingHom.id R. The standard Prod.instAddCommMonoid cache on MetricJet retains componentwise addition and zero. The revised type additionally selects the canonical CLM group and real normed-space structures for the output MetricJet ->L[R] Bilin, with source MetricJet, target Bilin, real scalars and identity real ring homomorphism. Its norm is exactly the existing CLM operator norm, with the original MetricJet product norm and Bilin norm; no replacement norm, scalar action, topology, or supplied instance hypothesis is introduced. The declaration has no universe parameters, manifold, spatial or time variable, Hoelder exponent, second metric jet, actual metric family, flow, quantitative bound, or supplied linear operator package. The assertion is local at invertible G0, not global smoothness across singular bilinear forms. It does not itself construct actual spatial coefficient fields or their compact-buffer bounds, prove differentiated covariance, supply the principal inverse-variation/second-jet contraction, define a bounded global L, or establish a signed residual/contraction or physical flow.
